[NCBK.11.1] Persisted series (`persist:` > 0) surface two callbacks; both are
specified under NSTG / NSBK and summarised here for the registry:

- **`sample_cb`** fires once per absorbed sample on a persisted series. NULL =
  silent drop (alarm on `ds.samples.dropped_total{reason="no_cb"}`). A non-OK
  return does not propagate to rules; it emits
  `ds.samples.dropped_total{reason="cb_error"}`.
- **`series_declared_cb`** fires once per persisted series at DSC-load time so
  the integrator can pre-provision backend storage. NULL = lazy-create from the
  first sample.

Series **backend** registration is not a callback, and v1 accepts no
integrator-supplied backend at all — see [NSBK.2.3].
